description:
Cast Green Dragon by paying {4}{G}{G}.
Green Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Terror of the Peaks.
Resolve the Green Dragon trigger, causing any creature your opponent control that are dealt damage this turn to be destroyed.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Green Dragon's power to any creature an opponent controls.
Green Dragon triggers, destroying the creature dealt damage.
The creature dies, triggering Overseer of the Damned's second ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing damage equal to the Zombie's power to any creature an opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.
